title: Still on for tonight?
setting: A quick three-way call. Maya, Chris, and Jordan are locking tonight's plan: where to meet, who gets a table, and how they'll get home. Familiar daily chat at a fast, reduced clip.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: You guys still on for tonight, or are we moving it?
lines.spoken: You guys still on for tonight, or are we moving it?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I'm still on, I just gotta leave work a little late. Like, I dunno, maybe seven-fifteen, seven-thirty?
lines.spoken: I'm still on, I just gotta leave work a little late. Like, I dunno, maybe seven-fifteen, seven-thirty?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: That's fine, I can go grab a table. You wanna just meet there?
lines.spoken: That's fine, I can go grab a table. You wanna just meet there?

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: I can meet there too, but I was gonna say, do we wanna do the place on Grant, or is that gonna be packed?
lines.spoken: I can meet there too, but I was gonna say, do we wanna do the place on Grant, or is that gonna be packed?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Grant's gonna be packed. We could do the other one, the quieter one, I don't remember the name, the one with the yellow sign.
lines.spoken: Grant's gonna be packed. We could do the other one, the quieter one, I don't remember the name, the one with the yellow sign.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah, I know the one. That's better. I'll text you the pin. You wanna just throw in for a cab after, or are we all taking the train?
lines.spoken: Yeah, I know the one. That's better. I'll text you the pin. You wanna just throw in for a cab after, or are we all taking the train?

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: I can throw in for a cab if it's not crazy. I don't wanna do three trains at night.
lines.spoken: I can throw in for a cab if it's not crazy. I don't wanna do three trains at night.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Same. Okay, so, yellow-sign place, Chris gets a table, I get there around seven-thirty, we get a cab after, we throw in. Did I miss anything?
lines.spoken: Same. Okay, so, yellow-sign place, Chris gets a table, I get there around seven-thirty, we get a cab after, we throw in. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: What we're eating. But we can figure that out there. Don't overthink it.
lines.spoken: What we're eating. But we can figure that out there. Don't overthink it.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: I'm gonna overthink it a little. I always do.
lines.spoken: I'm gonna overthink it a little. I always do.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I know you do. Just come.
lines.spoken: I know you do. Just come.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: I'm coming. I'm already putting my shoes on, kinda.
lines.spoken: I'm coming. I'm already putting my shoes on, kinda.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Okay, I'm muting, I gotta go back in. Text me if anything changes.
lines.spoken: Okay, I'm muting, I gotta go back in. Text me if anything changes.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: See you. Yellow sign. Don't go to Grant by accident.
lines.spoken: See you. Yellow sign. Don't go to Grant by accident.

gist.askZh: 今晚还去吗？他们最后定在哪见？
gist.askEn: Are they still on for tonight, and where do they meet?
accept: the quieter place with the yellow sign
黄招牌那家更安静的店

gist.askZh: 谁先到？结束后怎么回家？
gist.askEn: Who arrives first, and how will they get home?
accept: they'll throw in for a cab

details.askZh: 为什么不选 Grant 那家？
details.askEn: Why not the place on Grant?

details.askZh: Jordan 为什么不想坐火车？Maya 离开电话前交代了什么？
details.askEn: Why doesn't Jordan want the train, and what does Maya say before she hangs up?
accept: doesn't want three trains at night

glue.span: I just gotta leave work a little late
glue.hear: I just gotta leave work a little late
glue.noteZh: gotta leave work 缩得很紧，a little late 才是关键信息。180 的语速下，整句会一晃而过。
glue.standard: I just have got to leave work a little late

glue.span: You wanna just throw in for a cab after
glue.hear: You wanna just throw in for a cab after
glue.noteZh: wanna just throw in for a 几乎全是弱的功能词和语块，cab after 才落到实处。这是后面第一包会反复练的声音。
glue.standard: You want to just throw in for a cab after

glue.span: do we wanna do the place on Grant, or is that gonna be packed
glue.hear: do we wanna do the place on Grant, or is that gonna be packed
glue.noteZh: 一句里叠了 wanna 和 gonna，or is that 又很快。快语里先抓地点 Grant 和 packed，再回听中间的连接。
glue.standard: do we want to do the place on Grant, or is that going to be packed

chunks.form: You guys still on for tonight?
chunks.meaningZh: 你们今晚还是原计划吗？
chunks.sayAfter: You guys still on for tonight, or are we moving it?

chunks.meaningZh: 要不然就直接在那儿会合？
chunks.sayAfter: I can go grab a table. You wanna just meet there?

chunks.form: I can throw in for a cab.
chunks.sayAfter: I can throw in for a cab if it's not crazy.

roleplay.setupZh: 三个人要敲定今晚：还去不去、去哪家、谁先占桌、几点到、结束后怎么回家。语速可以快，但要把这几件事说清楚。
roleplay.aiRole: Play Chris and Jordan as needed. Chris can grab a table. Jordan worries Grant will be packed and doesn't want three trains at night. Keep it quick and overlapping, but don't run over the learner.
variants: They decide to move it after all.
The yellow-sign place is closed Mondays.
starters: You guys still on for tonight?
I can throw in for a cab.

fluency.promptZh: 用自己的话把今晚的计划讲完：还去、去哪、谁先到、Maya 几点到、回家怎么分打车钱。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Retell tonight's plan: they're still on, which place, who arrives first, Maya's time, and how they'll split a cab home. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
